$schema_note: Machine-readable map of this template for AI agents customizing it per client. Keep in sync with data-section/data-role attributes in src/components/*.tsx — if you add, remove, or rename a section/role in the code, update this file in the same change.

locale.note: All visible copy is Greek. html lang is set in src/app/layout.tsx.

font: DM Sans, loaded via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx

assets.note: Files in public/images are served from site root (public/images/foo.jpg -> /images/foo.jpg). No component currently reads from this folder — see public/images/README.md and AboutSection.tsx's placeholder div, the first candidate to wire up to a real image.

name.note: Hardcoded in three places, not a shared constant. Update all three for a client rebrand.

color.status: NOT WIRED UP — no component actually uses the brand-* utility classes. Every component hardcodes the literal arbitrary value text-[#0070f3] / bg-[#0070f3] instead.
color.note: A full brand-color change currently requires a literal find/replace of '#0070f3' across all files listed above, not just an edit to globals.css.

locations: src/components/Footer.tsx (email + phone + address, as plain text)

scrollAnchors.note: Section ids are targeted by nav hrefs (#id). If a section's id changes, update every href that points to it.

roleNamingConvention: data-role values describe FUNCTION, not location, and are reused across sections/components by design (e.g. multiple elements can share data-role="nav-link" or data-role="contact-button"). Always scope a data-role lookup within its nearest data-section ancestor.

header.note: Rendered once in page.tsx, outside <main>. Client component (has mobile menu state).

roles.logo: Link to '/' showing the brand name
roles.nav-link: One per navLinks entry; rendered TWICE (desktop nav + mobile dropdown), each occurrence tagged
roles.contact-button: Link to #contact; rendered TWICE (desktop pill button + mobile dropdown link)
roles.menu-toggle: Mobile hamburger button, no href, toggles the dropdown

roles.title: h1 headline
roles.subtitle: p supporting copy under the headline

roles.title: Section heading
roles.subtitle: Section intro paragraph
roles.service-item: Card wrapper, one per services[] entry
roles.item-description: Card body text, inside each service-item

services.shape: { title: string, description: string, icon: JSX <path> element }[]

untaggedContent.eyebrow span: Small label above the heading ('Σχετικά με εμάς'), no enumerated role fits it
untaggedContent.second paragraph: Additional body copy after the subtitle paragraph
untaggedContent.highlights list: highlights: string[] const at top of file, rendered as <li> items, not individually tagged
untaggedContent.image placeholder div: Marked in-code with a comment to replace with next/image when a real photo exists

cta.note: This is the id="contact" section — the template's 'contact' section is named cta, not contact, in data-section.

roles.logo: Brand name span (not a link, unlike the header logo)
roles.nav-link: 3 hardcoded <a> tags (not array-driven, unlike Header's navLinks)
roles.email-link:
Plain text

, not an actual mailto: anchor
roles.phone-link:
Plain text

, not an actual tel: anchor

untaggedContent.copyright line: Auto-generates the year via new Date().getFullYear()
untaggedContent.'Powered by agapps.eu' credit link: Template attribution, not client content — generally leave this untouched when customizing for a client
